asked.item: Is the credit drop from pressing Generate a glitch
Where to check the credit balance

verdict.reason: The FAQ says each Generate click on the free trial spends credits, even when testing, which explains the drop.

steps.text: Credits are only used for AI-generated images and videos.
Each time you click "Generate" on an image or video, credits are spent, even if you're testing.
On the free trial you receive a limited number of AI credits.
To check your balance, go to Settings > Billing.
